hook: orphan 怠惰團佔領沙發：indolent／slothful／lackadaisical／shiftless——遙控器比人先累。
script: indolent／slothful 懶。lackadaisical 無精打采。shiftless 無能懶散。laggard 落後者。loaf 閒混。口令：沙發寫「起來動」，遙控器寫「不是工作」。

members.senseAnchor: disinclined to work or exertion; (of tumors, e.g.) slow to heal or develop and usually painless
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 沙發人: indolent walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「沙發人」出場：indolent 一上場梗就黏住——懶惰的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 樹懶姿: slothful walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「樹懶姿」出場：slothful 一上場梗就黏住——怠惰的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 半開眼: lackadaisical walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「半開眼」出場：lackadaisical 一上場梗就黏住——無精打采的。

members.senseAnchor: lacking or characterized by lack of ambition or initiative; lazy

members.speakLineZh: 請「空工具」出場：shiftless 一上場梗就黏住——懶散無能的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 無清單: listless walks on and the gag sticks.

members.senseAnchor: slow and apathetic; in a condition of biological rest or suspended animation
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 冬眠: torpid walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「冬眠」出場：torpid 一上場梗就黏住——遲鈍的。
